name: Cost meter
summary: SEND fills the meter exchange by exchange; then the flip lands the same ask for pennies.

slots.label: Headline
slots.tooltip: The line across the top that says what is being priced

slots.label: Unit
slots.tooltip: What the numbers count, shown after every number, like tokens or dollars

slots.label: Messages sent
slots.tooltip: Each tap of Send adds the next one to the log and its cost to the meter, in this order

item.label: Message
item.tooltip: A short line naming what was asked

item.label: Cost
item.tooltip: How much this one message adds to the running total

slots.label: Guess-it line
slots.tooltip: Shown after the last Send: the question the room answers out loud before the twist

slots.label: The twist
slots.tooltip: The same ask done another way, with its much smaller cost — a label and a number that land last

slots.label: Closing line
slots.tooltip: The takeaway that fades in under the twist and stays on screen

props.label: Colour
props.tooltip: The colour of the meter, the Send button and the twist's highlight

content.call_it: Call it: what does the SAME ask cost on your own box?
content.reveal: The meter only ever runs one way in the cloud — locally it rounds to zero.
